captions_note: the sticker page replaces the picture and the handwritten notes are its words, so the reel's captions are hidden from the freeze on
in_a_reel: the buyer's style wins: set the note typeface, INK, ACCENT and PAGE from the reel's caption style before building (effects/INDEX.md, "Restyling an effect's own words")
F_OUT = None (the default) ends the slot on the sticker: put the slot at the end of the reel or end it on a cut. With an out frame the picture cuts back hard to plain footage
start the slot before F_FREEZE so its first frame is live picture, and LOOK at work/frames.jpg before baking: eyes open, no motion blur, no hand across the face. That one still is the whole effect
leave GRADE = '' (the reel owns the look). NOTES are the buyer's own words: never a number, result, handle or keyword the speaker does not say
steps: run onsets.py      # 1. word onsets as frames
edit put the word's onset in F_FREEZE (and note frames, F_OUT) in the CLIP block of build.py
run bake.py frames      # 2. LOOK at work/frames.jpg: eyes open, no motion blur, a good expression. This one still is the whole effect: move F_FREEZE if not
run bake.py      # 3. bakes the sticker and lays out the notes (5 s). Read its warnings, LOOK at work/check.jpg: border whole, green box on the head, notes clear of the sticker
run build.py SAFE=1      # page with the safe guide
hf snapshot --at 1.0,1.4,1.5,1.8,2.4      # your own times: just before the freeze, the freeze, landed, each note written
run build.py      # 4. clean page (no guide), then render
